title: 第15章 行会案发第16章 逃跑师娘
content_zh:
小刀会，正如路沉早前提过的，是由几个相当有资历的黑道头目凑成的帮派。
几个首领，都是从十几岁起就在巷子里厮混，虽然武功平平，却个个都是成了精的老江湖，几十年下来，手里攥着的人脉盘根错节，早已渗透进文安县的各个角落。
这帮人早年靠摆赌桌起家，攒下银钱便招兵买马，雇来高手撑场面。
一步步蚕食，竟将文安县的赌业尽数捏在手中，成了北城一方不容小觑的势力。
小刀会这名字，就取自市井泼皮惯用的攮子短刀。
会中老辈人物当年便是揣着这东西，从街边赌摊一路拼杀出来的。
久而久之，这把小小的攮子刀，就成了他们的标志。
城里的一些行当，早被各帮各派分了个干净。
肉行有屠夫帮，酒行归牙帮，米行被老鼠帮把持。
除了镖行、武行这类特殊行当，其余各行各业，几乎都有帮派和行会把持。
唯独彩票这门新冒出来的营生，至今还没立起山头，位置空悬。
路沉看准的，正是这个机会。
他要以此为基，将全城的彩票生意，攥在自己手里，成为这一行的会首！
翌日清晨。
路沉喊来瞎子，两人在院中过招。
他刻意催动新得的词条卡「梅枝颤影」，拳速陡然快了三分。
然而真正让瞎子叫苦不迭的，是那「寒梅透骨劲」。
路沉每一拳掠过，都带起一股刺骨寒意。
瞎子格挡时只觉寒气透骨，经脉像被冰针扎透，动作越来越僵。
“大哥，你这拳头邪门得很！”

瞎子跳开两步，揉着发青的手臂直哆嗦，“挨一下就跟掉进冰窟似的，骨头缝里都透着寒气！”
路沉收势而立，瞥见他手臂上凝着的白霜，心下了然。
这透骨寒劲，果然比单纯的快招更毒辣。
又过数日。
路沉的日子渐渐恢复了安稳。
韩老五这一失踪，羊圈街这块地盘，自然而然又回到了他手里。
有趣的是，先前韩老五设局、逼得路沉赔出三十两银子的事，如今反倒在南城传开了。
三十两可不是小数目，在南城，足够寻常五口之家嚼用一整年。多少干活的苦力，汗珠子摔八瓣地忙活一年，也攒不下这个数。
这消息像长了腿似的，在街巷间口耳相传，人人都在说
路沉这人讲规矩，输了认赔，是条汉子。
这么一来，路沉的彩票摊反倒因祸得福，名声更响了。
不少人宁可多绕两条街，也专程到他的摊子来玩。
加上再没韩老五这号人碍事，生意自是比往日更红火。
路沉在武馆的日子也过得规律。
每日天不亮就起身练拳，一招一式打磨得认真。
得空时，他便替师娘跑腿办事，采买些胭脂水粉。
就在路沉以为韩老五的事彻底了结时。
变故陡生。
深夜。
熟睡中的他突然惊醒。

院子里传来细微的响动，有人正翻墙跳进院子，而且不止一个。
这深更半夜摸他家院子的。
不是贼就是仇家。
路沉猛地探手摸向枕下，攥住那柄冰凉的剔骨尖刀，利落地蹬上棉裤，套紧袄子，穿好鞋，再把钱袋子塞进怀里。
这一连串动作又快又轻，像演练过无数遍。
content_en:
The Little Knife Society, as Lu Chen mentioned earlier, is a gang made up of several fairly qualified underworld leaders.
Several leaders have been hanging out in the alleys since they were teenagers. Although their martial arts skills are mediocre, they are all experienced veterans. Over the past few decades, the connections they have in their hands are intricate and have penetrated into every corner of Wen'an County.
This group of people started by setting up gambling tables in the early years. After saving money, they recruited soldiers and hired experts to support the scene.
Step by step, they gradually encroached on it, and actually had all the gambling industry in Wen'an County in their hands, becoming a force that cannot be underestimated in Beicheng.
The name "Xiao Dao Hui" comes from the short knife commonly used by gangsters in the market.
The elders in the association carried this thing and fought their way from street gambling stalls.
Over time, this small knife became their symbol.
Some businesses in the city have long been divided up by various gangs and factions.
The meat shop is owned by the Butcher Gang, the wine shop is owned by the Ya Gang, and the rice shop is controlled by the Rat Gang.
Except for special businesses such as escorts and martial arts, almost all other walks of life are controlled by gangs and guilds.
Only the lottery business, a new business, has not yet established its foothold, and its position is vacant.
It was this opportunity that Lu Chen was looking for.
Based on this, he wants to take the city's lottery business into his own hands and become the leader of this industry!
The next morning.
Lu Chen called the blind man, and they fought in the courtyard.
He deliberately activated the new entry card "Plum Branch Trembling Shadow", and his fist speed suddenly increased by three points.
However, what really caused the blind man to complain endlessly was the "bone-penetrating strength of the cold plum".
Lu Chen's every punch passed by, bringing with it a biting chill.
When the blind man blocked, he felt cold air penetrate his bones, his meridians felt like they were pierced by ice needles, and his movements became increasingly stiff.
"Brother, your fists are very evil!"
The blind man jumped two steps away, rubbing his blue arms and shivering, "It felt like falling into an ice cave after being hit, and there was cold air in the seams between the bones!"
Lu Chen stood up and caught a glimpse of the white frost on his arms, and felt relieved.
This bone-chilling energy is indeed more vicious than a simple quick move.
A few more days passed.
Lu Chen's life gradually returned to peace.
After Han Laowu disappeared, the territory of Yangquan Street naturally returned to his hands.
Interestingly, the story that Han Laowu set up a trap and forced Lu Chen to pay thirty taels of silver has now spread in Nancheng.
Thirty taels is not a small amount. In Nancheng, it is enough for an ordinary family of five to chew for a whole year. No matter how many coolies worked hard for a year, they could not save this amount.
The news seemed to have grown legs. It was spread by word of mouth in the streets and alleys. Everyone was talking about it.
Lu Chen follows the rules and accepts compensation when he loses. He is a man.
In this way, Lu Chen's lottery stall became a blessing in disguise and became even more famous.
Many people would rather go around two more streets and make a special trip to his stall.
With no one like Han Laowu getting in the way, business is naturally more prosperous than before.
Lu Chen's life in the martial arts hall was also regular.
He gets up before dawn every day to practice boxing, honing each move carefully.
When he had free time, he would run errands for his wife and buy some rouge and gouache.
Just when Lu Chen thought Han Laowu's matter was completely settled.
Changes occurred suddenly.
late at night.
He suddenly woke up from his deep sleep.
There was a slight noise in the yard. Someone was climbing over the wall and jumping into the yard, and there were more than one.
He touched his yard in the middle of the night.
Either a thief or an enemy.
Lu Chen suddenly reached under the pillow, grabbed the cold boning knife, quickly put on his cotton trousers, tightened his jacket, put on his shoes, and stuffed the money bag into his arms.
This series of movements was fast and light, as if it had been practiced countless times.
